io.title: Import and export products
io.noSharing: Sharing is not available on this phone.
io.hint: Up to 10,000 rows, from a CSV or an Excel (.xlsx) file in the template layout. Blank cells leave existing products unchanged. Errors are listed per row and column; nothing imports silently.
io.pick: Choose a CSV or Excel file
io.readFailed: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
io.size: The file is empty or too large.
io.hsn: HSN codes not in the library are confirmed
io.checked: File checked. Nothing is saved yet.
io.moreErrors: {{count}} more errors are in the report.

comp.hint: One per line: ingredient name, percentage, optional formulation (EC, WP, SC, SL, WG, DP, GR, FS, OTHER). Ingredients come from the ingredient master.

p.format: Line {{line}}: write the name, then a comma, then the percentage.
p.unknown: Line {{line}}: "{{name}}" is not in the ingredient master. Add it first.
p.pct: Line {{line}}: the percentage must be 0 to 100, up to 4 decimals.
p.formulation: Line {{line}}: the formulation must be EC, WP, SC, SL, WG, DP, GR, FS or OTHER.
p.twice: Line {{line}}: this ingredient is listed twice.

v.name: Write a name of up to 120 letters.
v.banReason: A banned ingredient needs a reason.

lab.title: Print labels
lab.hint: Product, price and barcode. One per line: product code, copies. Generate barcodes first on the product. The sheet is made as a PDF to print or share.
lab.bad: Line {{line}}: write the product code and 1 to 500 copies (at most 200 products).

lab.title: लेबल प्रिंट करें
lab.hint: उत्पाद, कीमत और बारकोड। हर पंक्ति में: उत्पाद कोड, प्रतियाँ। पहले उत्पाद पर बारकोड बनाएँ। शीट PDF बनती है, प्रिंट या शेयर के लिए।
